title: A Trajectory-Based Safety Audit of Clawdbot (OpenClaw)
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on agentic safety across six dimensions: User-facing deception, Hallucination & reliability failures, Intent misunderstanding & false assumptions, Unexpected results from ambitious goals, Operational safety awareness & efficiency, and Robustness to prompt injection & jailbreak.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
